sources: the 30 and 75 s run of 22 October on omni-v16, whose counts at those beats omni-v17 keeps (tools/model_gate.py --models pace_cloud,pace_kind --pace-periods 60,30,75 --seeds 1-8 --days 1)

the side study of 23 October on omni-v17, the beats between 15 and 60 s the ladder had not read, 20, 40, 45 and 50 s (tools/model_gate.py --models pace_cloud,pace_kind --pace-periods 60,45,40,50,20 --seeds 1-8 --days 1; the founder's words: 'I think 45 you didn't try'); its native and 60 s rows read the same seed by seed on every modelled gauge, the power cap's travel to its last bits and the governor's own processor apart, which is read against its own report's 60 s

first.source: the first 90 and 120 s run of 22 October, on omni-v16's rule
first.note: The 90 and 120 s beats as first run, before the cruise fix (docs/OMNI_V17.md, section 3): the cruise wait (120 s) rounded to one decision at those beats, so one reading with a pod waiting put every machine in service and one empty reading let them go. Kept here as the reading that caught the fault; the beats above are read from the corrected rule.
